text: Hypothesis only: terminal Product Proof semantics need canonical state mapping and explicit action reachability validation before Engineer spend. Harbor Courier canary #3 generated PR-MH-04 with state_reached state=failed, while proof-plan.mjs recognizes only success and failure. The compiled plan therefore omitted a failure-proof scenario, routed PR-MH-04 to base, reported requiredTerminalStates=[success], and still passed reachability validation. The best evidenced attempt then passed Technical and all Owner requirements except MH-04, MH-06 and MH-07. Its 75-second success-proof still ended playing rather than success. Validate first that terminal aliases such as failed/gameover are normalized to one canonical failure state and that unknown terminal-like state probes fail closed instead of silently routing to base. Separately validate whether a generic active verifier input is sufficient to prove success or whether scenario action reachability needs a harness-owned deterministic action policy. Do not change Production, activate this candidate, weaken Product Fidelity, or start another paid canary until deterministic regression fixtures establish the minimal remedy.
